points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in complex troubleshooting workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for technical support helpers.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable guidance from internal knowledge.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing processing overhead by ~80% per query and enabling efficient analytics.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant prompts by 25%, demonstrating capability in optimizing fleet management tasks.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI helpers using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for factory analytics.
